The query builds the full 71-tract population cohort, left-joins pre-aggregated 311 and code-violation counts, computes per-1,000-resident rates, and returns the correlation and paired tract count ordered by 311 rate descending.
sql:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT
    tr.geoid,
    tr.name,
    CAST(p.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM fw_pg.tracts tr
  JOIN session.fw_28edaa_m3_cdc_v2 p ON p.tractfips = tr.geoid
  WHERE CAST(p.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) > 0
),
tract_counts_agg AS (
  SELECT
    geoid,
    SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'm1_city_v2' THEN n END) AS n_311,
    SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'm2_city_v2' THEN n END) AS n_vio
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_28edaa'
    AND source IN ('m1_city_v2', 'm2_city_v2')
    AND grp = 'all'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
paired AS (
  SELECT
    c.name,
    COALESCE(tc.n_311, 0) * 1000.0 / c.totalpopulation AS rate_311_per_1000_residents,
    tc.n_vio * 1000.0 / c.totalpopulation AS rate_code_violation_per_1000_residents,
    COALESCE(tc.n_311, 0) AS n_311,
    COALESCE(tc.n_vio, 0) AS n_vio,
    c.totalpopulation,
    c.geoid
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN tract_counts_agg tc ON tc.geoid = c.geoid
)
SELECT
  name,
  rate_311_per_1000_residents,
  rate_code_violation_per_1000_residents,
  n_311,
  n_vio,
  totalpopulation,
  CORR(rate_311_per_1000_residents, rate_code_violation_per_1000_residents) OVER () AS correlation,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  geoid
FROM paired
ORDER BY rate_311_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, name ASC
LIMIT 200
